title: AI, ML & Nepali NLP
tagline: Language models, datasets, OCR, ASR, and translation for Nepali
description: Nepali NLP has matured rapidly: NepBERTa, IRIIS Nepal's 27.5GB corpus, Whisper fine-tunes for ASR, and AI4Bharat IndicTrans2 / NLLB-200 for translation. Note: Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-ne-en does not exist as a dedicated checkpoint — use NLLB or IndicTrans2 for production.

resources.name: NepBERTa
resources.description: RoBERTa pre-trained on ~0.8B Nepali words. Foundation for the Nep-gLUE benchmark. AACL-IJCNLP 2022.

resources.name: Sakonii/distilbert-base-nepali
resources.description: Apache-2.0. Trained on 13M sequences from OSCAR + CC-100 + Wikipedia.

resources.name: Sakonii/deberta-base-nepali
resources.description: Best-performing monolingual masked LM in the Sakonii series.

resources.name: IRIISNEPAL/Nepali-Text-Corpus
resources.description: Current SOTA Nepali corpus — 27.5GB / 6.4M articles. arXiv 2411.15734.

resources.name: IRIIS Nepali RoBERTa
resources.description: RoBERTa trained on the IRIIS 27.5GB corpus. SOTA on Nepali NLU benchmarks.

resources.name: AI4Bharat IndicTrans2
resources.description: MIT-licensed Indic translation suite. en-indic / indic-en, 1B + dist-200M. RoPE long-context updated Jan 2025. Best Indic-focused MT for Nepali.

resources.name: NLLB-200
resources.description: Meta NLLB-200. CC-BY-NC-4.0. Best open Nepali↔X translation across 200 languages.

resources.name: ai4bharat/indic-bert
resources.description: Multilingual ALBERT covering 12 Indic languages including Nepali.

resources.name: google/muril-base-cased
resources.description: Multilingual representations for 17 Indian languages.

resources.name: kiranpantha/whisper-large-v3-turbo-nepali
resources.description: Current SOTA Whisper fine-tune for Nepali ASR.

resources.name: OpenSLR SLR54 (Nepali ASR)
resources.description: ~157K Nepali utterances. CC-BY-SA-4.0. Standard ASR training corpus.

resources.name: OpenSLR SLR43 (Nepali TTS)
resources.description: Nepali TTS data — 18 female speakers.

resources.name: Mozilla Common Voice — Nepali
resources.description: Crowd-sourced Nepali (ne-NP) voice dataset. CC0.

resources.name: Indic-OCR Tessdata
resources.description: Improved Tesseract Devanagari/Nepali traineddata files.

resources.name: DHCD — Devanagari Handwritten Character Dataset
resources.description: 92K images / 46 classes. Standard Devanagari handwriting benchmark.

resources.name: fastText cc.ne.300
resources.description: 300-dim Nepali word embeddings from CommonCrawl + Wikipedia.

resources.name: NPVec1
resources.description: 25 SOTA Nepali embeddings on 279M tokens. ACL 2021.

resources.name: Nep-gLUE Benchmark
resources.description: 4-task Nepali NLU benchmark.

resources.name: EverestNER
resources.description: Nepali NER dataset — 24,587 entities. FLAIRS 2022.

resources.name: sushil79g/Nepali_nlp
resources.description: Most complete Nepali NLP toolkit — tokenization, summarization, news extraction, more.

resources.name: goru001/inltk
resources.description: Indic NLP toolkit (MIT) — Nepali first-class.

resources.name: Bhashini ULCA
resources.description: Indian govt MeitY platform. Nepali ASR + NMT + TTS available.

resources.name: NAAMII
resources.description: Nepal's flagship AI research institute. Runs ANAIS annual school since 2018 (6th edition 2025). github.com/naamiinepal.

resources.name: Fusemachines AI Fellowship
resources.description: NASDAQ:FUSE. AI Fellowship in Nepal since 2017 — 1,200+ fellows. Founder Dr. Sameer Maskey.

resources.name: Curated NLP — ghimiresunil
resources.description: Long-running curated list of Nepali NLP resources.
